domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of tegusts where I need to arrange the tegusts into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a tegust
   Unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust
   Put down a tegust
   Stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one tegust at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a tegust if my michime is winnilic.
   I can only pick up a tegust if the tegust is roperung atop the facizer and the tegust is nostactible. A tegust is nostactible if the tegust has no other tegusts roperung atop it and if the tegust is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking was really roperung atop the other tegust.
   I can only unstack a tegust from roperung atop another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking is nostactible.
   Once I pick up or unstack a tegust, I am jillerating the tegust.
   I can only put down a tegust that I am jillerating.
   I can only stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust if I am jillerating the tegust being stacked.
   I can only stack a tegust roperung atop another tegust if the tegust onto which I am stacking the tegust is nostactible.
   Once I put down or stack a tegust, my michime becomes winnilic.
   Once you stack a tegust roperung atop a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer nostactible.

               (not (nostactible ?undertegust)) (not (jillerating ?tegust))))

   Unstack a sionesson from impolitz atop another sionesson
   Put down a sionesson
   Stack a sionesson impolitz atop another sionesson

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one sionesson at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a sionesson if my extraord is eutersous.

   I can only put down a sionesson that I am exiving.
   I can only stack a sionesson impolitz atop another sionesson if I am exiving the sionesson being stacked.
   I can only stack a sionesson impolitz atop another sionesson if the sionesson onto which I am stacking the sionesson is invaliersal.
   Once I put down or stack a sionesson, my extraord becomes eutersous.
   Once you stack a sionesson impolitz atop a second sionesson, the second sionesson is no longer invaliersal.

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (crunemiesory ?x)
             (ablerser overprimon ?x)

             (bricalling ?x)

  :parameters  (?readiny)
  :precondition (bricalling ?readiny)
  :effect (and (crunemiesory ?readiny) (horibedalpessional) (ablerser overprimon ?readiny)
               (not (bricalling ?readiny))))

  :precondition (and (crunemiesory ?underreadiny) (bricalling ?readiny))
  :effect (and (horibedalpessional) (crunemiesory ?readiny) (ablerser over ?readiny ?underreadiny)
               (not (crunemiesory ?underreadiny)) (not (bricalling ?readiny))))

(:action unstack
  :parameters  (?readiny ?underreadiny)
  :precondition (and (ablerser over ?readiny ?underreadiny) (crunemiesory ?readiny) (horibedalpessional))
  :effect (and (bricalling ?readiny) (crunemiesory ?underreadiny)

  :precondition (jillerating ?paciter)
  :effect (and (quotrokesal ?paciter) (vloverauctedous) (flecial overtubackey ?paciter)
               (not (jillerating ?paciter))))

  :effect (and (vloverauctedous) (quotrokesal ?paciter) (flecial over ?paciter ?underpaciter)
               (not (quotrokesal ?underpaciter)) (not (jillerating ?paciter))))

  :parameters  (?paciter ?underpaciter)
  :precondition (and (flecial over ?paciter ?underpaciter) (quotrokesal ?paciter) (vloverauctedous))
  :effect (and (jillerating ?paciter) (quotrokesal ?underpaciter)

   I can only stack a birmon chamess upon another birmon if I am nienting the birmon being stacked.
   I can only stack a birmon chamess upon another birmon if the birmon onto which I am stacking the birmon is chutive.
   Once I put down or stack a birmon, my ludite becomes reseymonible.
   Once you stack a birmon chamess upon a second birmon, the second birmon is no longer chutive.

(define (domain blocksworld-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (berrowlsic ?x)
             (symbers uponbumbelvell ?x)
             (pedilatorcreagerent)
             (cabudging ?x)
             (symbers upon ?x ?y))

(:action pick-up
  :parameters (?plaine)
  :precondition (and (berrowlsic ?plaine) (symbers uponbumbelvell ?plaine) (pedilatorcreagerent))
  :effect (and (cabudging ?plaine) (not (berrowlsic ?plaine)) (not (symbers uponbumbelvell ?plaine))
               (not (pedilatorcreagerent))))

(:action put-down
  :parameters  (?plaine)
  :precondition (cabudging ?plaine)
  :effect (and (berrowlsic ?plaine) (pedilatorcreagerent) (symbers uponbumbelvell ?plaine)
               (not (cabudging ?plaine))))

(:action stack
  :parameters  (?plaine ?underplaine)
  :precondition (and (berrowlsic ?underplaine) (cabudging ?plaine))
  :effect (and (pedilatorcreagerent) (berrowlsic ?plaine) (symbers upon ?plaine ?underplaine)
               (not (berrowlsic ?underplaine)) (not (cabudging ?plaine))))

(:action unstack
  :parameters  (?plaine ?underplaine)
  :precondition (and (symbers upon ?plaine ?underplaine) (berrowlsic ?plaine) (pedilatorcreagerent))
  :effect (and (cabudging ?plaine) (berrowlsic ?underplaine)
               (not (symbers upon ?plaine ?underplaine)) (not (berrowlsic ?plaine)) (not (pedilatorcreagerent)))))

  :precondition (eveticaling ?posidele)
  :effect (and (aquardable ?posidele) (fordisonmarxisible) (tuituted overrophys ?posidele)

  :effect (and (fordisonmarxisible) (aquardable ?posidele) (tuituted over ?posidele ?underposidele)

(:action unstack
